observation.visible_scene: A brightly lit dance studio with white walls, a light wood floor, a ceiling-mounted air-conditioner, a row of track lights, and a wall-to-wall mirror. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a yellow-and-gold sequined belly-dance costume (sequined halter top, layered yellow skirt over gold sequin trousers), stands with her back to the camera facing the mirror; her smiling frontal reflection is visible in the glass. She performs a sequence of arm and hip movements throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: Arms move through a repeating pattern: raised near the head (t=0.0), then folded/crossed in front of the chest (t=0.13-0.27), then opened and extended wide to the sides (t=0.47-0.73), then bent with one hand framing the head and the other resting on the hip (t=0.8-1.2), then crossed and pushed forward again (t=1.33-1.67), then swept wide and one arm raised high (t=1.73-2.13), then the right hand held at the forehead in a salute-like pose with the left hand on the hip from t=2.2 to the end (t=2.67).
The hips sway side to side during the arm transitions, causing the loose yellow skirt and gold sequin fabric to flare and shift laterally (most visibly to her left around t=0.27-0.4 and t=0.53-0.73).
The torso and head rotate slightly as she shifts weight, but her overall standing position relative to the mirror stays roughly centered with no large translation across the floor.
The mirror reflection reproduces all of the above changes in real time, confirming the reflected figure is the same dancer, not a second person.
The background elements (wall, mirror seams, ceiling lights, AC unit) hold fixed positions frame to frame, indicating the camera is stationary and the apparent motion is the dancer's body.
outside_clip_unknowns: The beginning and end of the full dance phrase are cut off; the routine is already in progress at t=0 and continues past t=2.67.
Whether any footwork or traveling steps occur outside this segment is not shown; within it the feet remain largely planted.
The accompanying music or any external cue driving the movements is not visible.
uncertain_details: Subtle weight shifts and small foot adjustments are hard to resolve at this frame rate; the dancer appears to pivot in place rather than step.
The hand-at-forehead pose is held nearly static from t=2.2 onward, with only minor body sway, so it reads as a sustained position rather than a transition.
Exact camera motion cannot be confirmed beyond 'background appears fixed', so slight handheld drift cannot be fully ruled out.
